description: Use when an agent needs scholarly papers on a topic. Returns OpenAlex works (CC0 data) for a search: title, year, DOI, authors, venue, citation count and open-access link, up to 25, optionally from a given year. Cached 24 hours. Costs 0.015 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

q.description: the search text, up to 200 characters

name: get_papers

data.description: the get_papers payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_papers

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Paper search
